verdict.rationale: Reducto documents an enterprise on-prem/VPC deployment option where customer data and storage reside in the customer's VPC, but processing itself still runs on Reducto's own dedicated GPU infrastructure rather than fully within customer control — this is a hybrid deployment, not a true self-hosted core product. Missing for 10: evidence of a fully self-hostable runtime/container image, independent confirmation of on-prem processing (not just storage), and details on how much of the 'core product' (parse/extract/agentic pipeline) can run entirely on customer infrastructure.
